Reduce the pond to a garden-scale feature and add a readable upper row of roughly 8-10 px roofs, with gardens and driveways. Preserve compatible perimeter roads and carry the corrected geometry through all four seasons.

fail.name: suburb-4
fail.problems: The upper half is dominated by a large L-shaped commercial/service roof and paved forecourt, leaving only two detached houses in the bottom row. That roof is several house widths across and breaks the required small detached-house scale and two-row layout. Replace the oversized complex with individual upper-row houses, gardens and connected drives; retain the perimeter street connections and use the same corrected plan in every season.

fail.name: suburb-7
